svg.title: firecrawl/firecrawl: 61% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 61% of 499 recent commits in firecrawl/firecrawl carry a disclosed AI agent signature (newest 499 commits, since 2026-09-23). Capy 33%, Claude Code 24%, Cursor 3.6%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
